evaluation_policy: Do not modify frozen tasks, rubric, Planner Contract, Runtime Cards, router prompt, or success criteria after inspecting scored v3 results.
The Generic Planner controls for extra planning compute; method-specific credit requires Method Planner to beat Generic Planner.
Judges receive only reasoning-sanitized final answers.
Difficulty is defined structurally by hardness_features before any scored Vanilla comparison; do not post-hoc select tasks by observed Vanilla failures.
Task Gain v1/v2 remain development evidence and are not reused as clean v3 tasks.
